Emberfall merchant and exotic weapon asset credits
Source page licenses verified: 2026-10-12

npc-eye-squaller.glb: "Eye Summoner" by Polygonal Mind
Source: https://poly.pizza/m/3DS872gR6u
Original model download: https://static.poly.pizza/0a0ca1fb-da7c-4a03-96b5-300b7bfd273d.glb
License: CC0 1.0 — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Original SHA-256: 5d8b01f930c61c13a72393498db32225fc03364c84fa994d06f546e171b8113d
Changes: The static mesh was turned to face +Z, scaled to 1.85 m with feet at Y=0, and its face shape keys were removed. It was skinned to the 19-bone Emberfall rig from avatar-wizard.glb, with joints refitted to this body and bone orientations kept, so that rig's 16 clips play on it. Weights came from automatic weights on a voxel-remeshed copy, transferred to the original mesh; the arms are weighted along their length, and the helmet follows the head. quaternius-npc-eye-squaller-animations.glb holds the Universal Animation Library clips retargeted by scripts/import-quaternius.mjs. Texture and material were kept.

assets/voice/merchant-welcome.mp3 and assets/voice/merchant-come-get-your-weapons.mp3: Eye Squaller's voice lines, recorded for Emberfall. Silence was trimmed from the start and end, and they were re-encoded as 128 kb/s mono MP3.
Original SHA-256 (welcome): 95dffe89522f884e30d75b138826970aa94515da4ccf1ebc182679212c1d962d
Original SHA-256 (come get your weapons): 4153196958f1ea684c1713a4e6608c79f09e29565a83e64fa45d02cfa8961c25

The weapons below were rotated so the blade points +Y, scaled to 1.2 m, and moved so the grip sits at the origin. Geometry and materials were kept.
